study_type: independent-participant development-holdout confirmation, same source site not external validation
exclusion_definition: AR = over 25% trials rejected due to artifact; TC = less than 50% rare trials remaining after artifact rejection; ACC = total accuracy lower than 75%. Source: P3_Subject_Summary.xlsx on the OSF record (sha256 063b26a665e3cf27...). Total usable 34, matching the paper's P3 N=34.
selection_rule: All and only the 14 eligible ERP CORE P3 participants not in the original fixed 20-person development cohort, sorted by subject ID; no outcome-based exclusions

algorithm.independent_ICA_seed_sets: required if claiming recommendation stability beyond a tautological same-seed minimax choice

reference.measure: target minus standard difference wave, mean amplitude over 300-600 ms at Pz
reference.tool_reference: average (pop_pipecompare 'reference' accepts only 'asis' | 'average'; no P9/P10 channel-list reference exists, so the tool arms use average reference exactly as in the PR51 pilot. The published-pipeline P9/P10 reference amplitude is computed separately in MATLAB, not through pop_pipecompare.)
reference.search: Full Standard search, Presets.searchOptions unchanged (icaSeeds 2, refineCutoffs, eogCheck, signalTemplate 'data')
reference.primary_endpoint: Per-participant bootstrap SE (1000 trial resamples, seed 520004 + subject) of the gain-corrected P3 difference amplitude, recomputed by the collector from the saved per-trial scores and weights. Independent of the tool's own SME and reported error.
reference.interval_rule: Record bootstrap order statistic ceil((B+1)*q), clipped to [1,B]; retain all draws.

trial_rules.event_codes: Two-digit stimulus codes; tens digit = block target letter (1=A..5=E), ones digit = shown letter. Target when tens == ones (11, 22, 33, 44, 55); otherwise standard. Responses: 201 = correct, 202 = error.
trial_rules.relabeling: Target codes -> '11', standard codes -> '31', response events dropped after correctness/RT filtering. Required because pop_pipecompare 'events' accepts one condition per event type and cannot express target = 5 codes / standard = 20 codes. Original codes, correctness and RTs are preserved in input.mat trials.* and source.json, so the relabeling is fully auditable.
trial_rules.epoch_fit_rule: Stimuli with onset < 0.2 s or > duration - 0.8 s are excluded so the full -200..800 ms epoch fits inside the excerpt.
trial_rules.fdt_parsing: EEGLAB .fdt is little-endian float32 written column-major (time-major on disk); reshape Fortran-order (nbchan x pnts, order='F'). A C-order reshape scrambles channels into white noise (verified on sub-001: flat spectrum above 30 Hz, no power below; Fortran order restores 1/f spectrum and neighbour correlation ~0.98).
trial_rules.dc_offsets: Recordings carry large DC offsets and slow drift (sub-001 Pz std ~86-108 uV raw, ~9 uV after the paper's 0.1 Hz high-pass). Fetch subtracts the per-channel mean over the excerpt only; high-pass filtering is left to the pipelines under test (the Standard search and both fixed arms include a 0.1 Hz high-pass). The tool's blink reference is drift-immune by design (baseline-subtracted window means with robust z-scores; sampleHits subtracts a 1 s moving median).

excerpt.note: Duration is 300 s under Amendment A1 (see amendment). The approved draft said 180 s; verified trial counts from the downloaded events.tsv files showed 180 s cannot meet the trial floors (5 of 20 subjects below 15 valid targets), so the excerpt was lengthened to 300 s with floors unchanged. Still a short excerpt of a ~8-10 min task.

frozen_after_algorithm_selection_gates.precision: 95% paired participant-bootstrap CI upper bound <0 for robust minus each fixed control; no participant deletion
frozen_after_algorithm_selection_gates.seed_stability_target: At least 13 of 14 participants same robust recommended recipe across two predeclared DISJOINT seed-triplets (>=90%); must first implement and pin this independent replication
